content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-notion-templates-crypto-what-actually-how-works-8|Selling Notion]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-4|complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-notion-templates-crypto-guide-leaves-3|COREMERCH guide to everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The ability to sell Notion templates without relying on traditional payment processors opens new avenues for digital creators. With platforms like Gumroad charging up to 10% on sales, creators lose significant revenue. By using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, you retain more of your earnings, allowing you to invest further into your creations. This is particularly critical for creators in regions with limited payment solutions, where keeping costs low directly impacts profitability.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling digital products consists of multiple components that work seamlessly together. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, automating the delivery of your Notion templates after payment confirmation. Supabase or Google Sheets serves as your order storage solution, ensuring you have complete data ownership. This structure allows for a streamlined process that minimizes overhead while maximizing efficiency, making it ideal for creators who want a straightforward sales setup.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This framework is designed for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where access to mainstream payment processors is often restricted. It empowers these creators to sell their digital products, such as Notion templates, directly to their audience using cryptocurrency. By providing a solution that avoids the high fees of platforms like PayPal and Gumroad, creators can keep more of their earnings and build sustainable businesses.
Retain more of your earnings by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components include Cloudflare Pages for hosting your sales pages, Google Drive for file delivery, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Each component plays a vital role in the overall architecture: Cloudflare Pages ensures fast and reliable hosting, while Google Drive allows you to easily manage and distribute your digital products. NOWPayments streamlines the payment process, enabling you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring your business remains profitable.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates, follow these steps: First, set up your Cloudflare Pages account to host your sales page. Next, create a Google Sheets or Supabase database for order management. Then, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions automatically. Finally, upload your templates to Google Drive and link them to your sales page for instant delivery. All these components come together to create a cohesive sales infrastructure that you control.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your digital product delivery with minimal setup.

If you're looking to enhance your digital product sales, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is an excellent resource. It includes all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, helping you effectively sell Notion templates and other digital products. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can use a combination of Cloudflare Pages, Google Sheets, and NOWPayments to create your own sales infrastructure. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly and manage your orders without relying on traditional payment processors.

The most effective way is to build your own sales architecture using free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Workers alongside NOWPayments. This setup drastically reduces fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Absolutely. By using NOWPayments for payment processing and a simple hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages, you can sell your templates and fonts directly to your audience while avoiding unnecessary fees.
What payment options are available for my digital products?

You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, including popular options like Bitcoin and USDT. This flexibility allows you to cater to a global audience while minimizing transaction costs.
How do I automate the delivery of my digital products?

Automate delivery by integrating Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers into your sales process. These tools can handle the delivery of your digital products immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth customer experience.
Own your sales infrastructure without relying on third-party platforms.
